```{r load}
library(Seurat)
library(anndataR)
library(Matrix)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(BPCells)
library(harmony)
library(recipes)
library(themis)
library(caret)
library(xgboost)
library(ranger)
library(glmnet)
set.seed(501)

adata <- read_h5ad("../shared objs and code/external mouse datasets/johnston et al MERFISH_Data.h5ad", as = "HDF5AnnData")

counts <- adata$layers[["RNA"]] |> t() |> as("dgCMatrix")
dimnames(counts) <- list(adata$var_names, adata$obs_names)

meta <- as.data.frame(adata$obs)
rownames(meta) <- adata$obs_names

#add sex based on batch
#batch 1 - female
#batch 2 - ntg: trem2r47h male; 5xfad - female
#batch 3 - 5 male


spatial_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, meta.data = meta, assay = "RNA")

mic_seurat <- spatial_obj[, spatial_obj$cluster == "Mic" & spatial_obj$region_labels == "Hypothalamus"]

# Genes detected in >= 50 microglia
mic_counts <- LayerData(mic_seurat, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
keep_genes <- rownames(mic_counts)[rowSums(mic_counts > 0) >= 50]
mic_seurat <- mic_seurat[keep_genes, ]

# Cells with > 100 counts (recomputed on the kept genes)
mic_seurat$nCount_kept <- colSums(LayerData(mic_seurat, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts"))
summary(mic_seurat$nCount_kept)
sum(mic_seurat$nCount_kept > 100)   # check how many cells survive before committing
mic_seurat <- mic_seurat[, mic_seurat$nCount_kept > 100]

spatial_mic_ge <- LayerData(mic_seurat, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
spatial_meta   <- mic_seurat@meta.data
```

```{r mic-harmony}
get_pcs_no_var_genes = function(initial_ge_matrix, nthreads = 8, npcs = 30) {
  initial_ge_matrix <- multiply_cols(initial_ge_matrix, 1/Matrix::colSums(initial_ge_matrix))
  initial_ge_matrix <- log1p(initial_ge_matrix * 1e4) # Log transform
  #use function to get mean and stdev
  variable_genes <- Seurat::FindVariableFeatures(initial_ge_matrix) 
  variable_genes$gene = rownames(variable_genes)
  variable_genes$standard_deviation = sqrt(variable_genes$variance)
  gene_means <- variable_genes$mean
  gene_std <- variable_genes$standard_deviation
  #write to disk before breaking sparsity via z-score
  preprocessed_ge = initial_ge_matrix %>% write_matrix_dir(tempfile("mat"), overwrite = T)
  #z-score
  preprocessed_ge <- (preprocessed_ge - gene_means) / gene_std
  #calculate PCs 
  svd <- BPCells::svds(preprocessed_ge, k = npcs, threads = nthreads)
  pca <- multiply_cols(svd$v, svd$d)
  rownames(pca) = colnames(preprocessed_ge)
  colnames(pca) = paste("PC_",seq(1,ncol(pca)))
  return(pca)

}
pcs_micro= get_pcs_no_var_genes(joint_ge, npcs = 20)

harmony_micro = RunHarmony(pcs_micro,meta_data = joint_meta$tech)
```



Test 80/20 train/test of xgb, rf, and ridge regression. Choose best performing model for full analysis. 
```{r classifier-helpers}

# --- align embedding with metadata -------------------------------------------
emb <- as.matrix(harmony_micro)
colnames(emb) <- paste0("PC", seq_len(ncol(emb)))
stopifnot(all(rownames(emb) == joint_meta$cell_id))

snrna_idx <- which(joint_meta$tech == "snRNA")
spatial_idx <- which(joint_meta$tech == "merfish")

X_snrna <- emb[snrna_idx, , drop = FALSE]#embedding
y_snrna <- factor(joint_meta$cluster[snrna_idx])#cluster
X_spatial <- emb[spatial_idx, , drop = FALSE]

# --- 80/20 stratified train/test split ---------------------------------------
train_idx <- createDataPartition(y_snrna, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)[, 1]

X_train_raw <- X_snrna[train_idx, ]
y_train_raw <- y_snrna[train_idx]
X_test      <- X_snrna[-train_idx, ]
y_test      <- y_snrna[-train_idx]

# --- SMOTE balancing on training set only ------------------------------------
train_df <- as.data.frame(X_train_raw)
train_df$cluster <- y_train_raw

train_df_capped <- train_df %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 5000) %>%
  ungroup()

smote_rec <- recipe(cluster ~ ., data = train_df_capped) %>%
  step_smote(cluster, over_ratio = 1) %>%
  prep()

train_balanced <- juice(smote_rec)
X_train <- as.matrix(train_balanced %>% select(-cluster))
y_train <- train_balanced$cluster

# --- XGBoost -----------------------------------------------------------------
y_levels    <- levels(factor(y_train))
y_train_int <- as.integer(factor(y_train, levels = y_levels)) - 1L

dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_train, label = y_train_int)

params <- list(
  objective   = "multi:softprob",
  num_class   = length(y_levels),
  eval_metric = "mlogloss"
)

cv_xgb <- xgb.cv(
  params  = params,
  data    = dtrain,
  nrounds = 500,
  nfold   = 5,
  early_stopping_rounds = 20,
  verbose = 0
)

xgb_model <- xgb.train(
  params  = params,
  data    = dtrain,
  nrounds = cv_xgb$early_stop$best_iteration
)

P_xgb_test    <- predict(xgb_model, newdata = X_test)
xgb_test_pred <- factor(y_levels[max.col(P_xgb_test)], levels = levels(y_test))

# --- Random Forest (ranger) --------------------------------------------------
rf_model <- ranger(
  x = X_train,
  y = factor(y_train),
  classification = TRUE,
  seed = 501
)

rf_test_pred <- predict(rf_model, data = X_test)$predictions
rf_test_pred <- factor(rf_test_pred, levels = levels(y_test))

# --- Ridge GLMNet ------------------------------------------------------------
cvfit <- cv.glmnet(
  x = X_train, y = y_train,
  family = "multinomial", type.measure = "class",
  alpha = 0, nfolds = 5, parallel = FALSE
)

P_glm_test    <- drop(predict(cvfit, newx = X_test, s = "lambda.min", type = "response"))
glm_test_pred <- factor(colnames(P_glm_test)[max.col(P_glm_test)], levels = levels(y_test))

# --- Compare all three on held-out snrna test set ----------------------------
cm_xgb <- confusionMatrix(xgb_test_pred, y_test)
cm_rf  <- confusionMatrix(rf_test_pred,  y_test)
cm_glm <- confusionMatrix(glm_test_pred, y_test)

summary_df <- data.frame(
  model             = c("XGBoost", "Random Forest", "Ridge GLMNet"),
  accuracy          = c(cm_xgb$overall["Accuracy"],
                        cm_rf$overall["Accuracy"],
                        cm_glm$overall["Accuracy"]),
  kappa             = c(cm_xgb$overall["Kappa"],
                        cm_rf$overall["Kappa"],
                        cm_glm$overall["Kappa"]),
  balanced_accuracy = c(mean(cm_xgb$byClass[, "Balanced Accuracy"], na.rm = TRUE),
                        mean(cm_rf$byClass[, "Balanced Accuracy"],  na.rm = TRUE),
                        mean(cm_glm$byClass[, "Balanced Accuracy"], na.rm = TRUE))
)

print(summary_df)

# Per-class F1 for each model
f1_df <- data.frame(
  class     = rownames(cm_xgb$byClass),
  f1_xgb    = cm_xgb$byClass[, "F1"],
  f1_rf     = cm_rf$byClass[, "F1"],
  f1_glmnet = cm_glm$byClass[, "F1"]
)

print(f1_df)

#use random forest because highest f1 for mic-4 (DAM 2 cluster) and mic-5 and highest accuracy
```

```{r mic-rf-final}
set.seed(501)

# --- Balance ALL snRNA microglia (same cap + SMOTE as the benchmark) ----------
full_df <- as.data.frame(X_snrna)
full_df$cluster <- y_snrna

full_df_capped <- full_df %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 5000) %>%
  ungroup()

full_balanced <- recipe(cluster ~ ., data = full_df_capped) %>%
  step_smote(cluster, over_ratio = 1) %>%
  prep() %>%
  juice()

X_full <- as.matrix(full_balanced %>% select(-cluster))
y_full <- full_balanced$cluster

# --- Final random forest (probability forest so we get class probabilities) ---
rf_final <- ranger(
  x = X_full,
  y = y_full,
  probability = TRUE,
  seed = 501
)

# --- Predict MERFISH microglia: highest-probability cluster, no unassigned ----
P_rf_spatial <- predict(rf_final, data = X_spatial)$predictions
rownames(P_rf_spatial) <- rownames(X_spatial)

mic_assign <- tibble(
  cell_id  = rownames(P_rf_spatial),
  cluster  = colnames(P_rf_spatial)[max.col(P_rf_spatial, ties.method = "first")],
  max_prob = unname(apply(P_rf_spatial, 1, max))
) %>%
  left_join(select(joint_meta, cell_id, orig_id, sample, gen), by = "cell_id")

summary(mic_assign$max_prob)

# --- Store on the Seurat object ----------------------------------------------
m <- match(colnames(mic_seurat), mic_assign$orig_id)
mic_seurat$rf_cluster  <- setNames(mic_assign$cluster[m],  colnames(mic_seurat))
mic_seurat$rf_max_prob <- setNames(mic_assign$max_prob[m], colnames(mic_seurat))
```




```{r cluster-counts}
drop_r47h <- FALSE   # TRUE = WT vs 5xFAD only (drop Trem2R47H animals)

# ---- Sample x genotype pieces -> animal, sex (from Johnston et al. Methods) ----
section_info <- spatial_obj[[]] |>
  distinct(sample, coarse_batch, gen, gen_coarse) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) |>
  mutate(
    fad   = factor(if_else(str_detect(gen_coarse, "5xFAD"), "FAD",  "nonFAD"), levels = c("nonFAD", "FAD")),
    trem2 = factor(if_else(str_detect(gen_coarse, "Trem2"), "R47H", "WT"),     levels = c("WT", "R47H")),
    sex = case_when(
      coarse_batch == "1"                  ~ "F",   # WT + 5xFAD, both female
      coarse_batch == "2" & fad == "FAD"   ~ "F",   # Trem2R47H;5xFAD female
      coarse_batch == "2"                  ~ "M",   # Trem2R47H male
      TRUE                                 ~ "M"    # batches 3-5 all male
    ),
    animal_id = paste(coarse_batch, gen_coarse, sep = "_")   # replicate slices (batches 1-2) share an ID
  )

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(section_info[, c("sample", "gen")]))

animal_info <- section_info |>
  distinct(animal_id, coarse_batch, gen_coarse, sex, fad, trem2)

stopifnot(nrow(animal_info) == 15)                # paper: 15 animals
table(animal_info$gen_coarse, animal_info$sex)

if (drop_r47h) {
  section_info <- filter(section_info, trem2 == "WT")
  animal_info  <- filter(animal_info,  trem2 == "WT")
}

# ---- Counts: one row per cluster x animal (zeros filled in) ----
cluster_counts <- mic_assign |>
  transmute(sample = as.character(sample), gen = as.character(gen), cluster) |>
  inner_join(select(section_info, sample, gen, animal_id), by = c("sample", "gen")) |>#get animal id for each sample/genotype
  dplyr::count(animal_id, cluster, name = "count") |>
  complete(animal_id, cluster, fill = list(count = 0)) |>
  left_join(animal_info, by = "animal_id") |>
  mutate(cluster   = factor(cluster, levels = str_sort(unique(cluster), numeric = TRUE)),
         animal_id = factor(animal_id))

cluster_counts |>
  group_by(animal_id, gen_coarse, sex, fad) |>
  summarise(n_mic = sum(count), .groups = "drop")
```


Plot on the sections 
```{r mic-spatial, fig.width = 16, fig.height = 12}
# ---- Panel labels: 5xFAD / Trem2 / sex, ordered so matching animals sit together ----
panel_info <- section_info |>
  as_tibble() |>
  dplyr::select(sample, gen, animal_id, coarse_batch, fad, trem2, sex) |>
  arrange(fad, trem2, sex, coarse_batch, sample) |>
  group_by(animal_id) |>
  mutate(n_slices = n(),
         slice    = if_else(n_slices > 1, paste0(" · slice ", row_number(), "/", n_slices), "")) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    fad_lab   = if_else(fad == "FAD", "5xFAD", "Ntg"),
    trem2_lab = if_else(trem2 == "R47H", "Trem2 R47H", "Trem2 WT"),
    sex_lab   = if_else(sex == "F", "Female", "Male"),
    panel     = paste0(fad_lab, " | ", trem2_lab, " | ", sex_lab, "\n",
                       "batch ", coarse_batch, slice),
    panel     = factor(panel, levels = unique(panel))
  )

# ---- Hypothalamic cells with mapped microglia labels ----
plot_df <- spatial_obj[[]] |>
  rownames_to_column("cell") |>
  dplyr::select(cell, sample, gen, region_labels, center_x, center_y) |>
  filter(region_labels == "Hypothalamus") |>
  mutate(sample = as.character(sample), gen = as.character(gen)) |>
  inner_join(dplyr::select(panel_info, sample, gen, panel), by = c("sample", "gen")) |>
  left_join(dplyr::select(mic_assign, cell = orig_id, mapped_cluster = cluster), by = "cell") |>
  mutate(
    highlight = case_when(
      mapped_cluster %in% c("microglia-4", "microglia-5") ~ mapped_cluster,
      !is.na(mapped_cluster)                              ~ "other post-qc microglia",
      TRUE                                                ~ "background"
    ),
    highlight = factor(highlight, levels = c("background", "other post-qc microglia",
                                             "microglia-5", "microglia-4"))
  ) |>
  group_by(sample, gen) |>                       # each hemisphere on its own origin
  mutate(x = center_x - min(center_x),
         y = center_y - min(center_y)) |>#change scale
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(highlight)                             # highlighted cells drawn on top

dam_validation_on_sections = ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = filter(plot_df, highlight == "background"),
             aes(x, y), color = "grey90", size = 0.3, shape = 16) +
  geom_point(data = filter(plot_df, highlight != "background"),
             aes(x, y, color = highlight), size = 1.2, shape = 16) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(`microglia-4`              = "#E69F00",
               `microglia-5`              = "#56B4E9",
               `other post-qc microglia`  = "black"),
    breaks = c("microglia-4", "microglia-5", "other post-qc microglia"),
    name   = NULL
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel) +
  coord_fixed() + scale_y_reverse() +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text = element_text(size = 8)) +
  ggtitle("Microglia-4 and microglia-5 in MERFISH hypothalamus")

ggsave("dam-mic-validation-merfish.pdf",dam_validation_on_sections, width = 10, height = 10)
```


```{r model-prep}
library(sccomp)
library(voomCLR)
library(limma)
library(ANCOMBC)
library(TreeSummarizedExperiment)

# Drop inherited cell-level row names; sex as a factor, male = reference (coefficient: sexF)
animal_info <- animal_info |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(sex = factor(sex, levels = c("M", "F")))

cluster_counts <- cluster_counts |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(sex = factor(sex, levels = c("M", "F")))

table(animal_info$fad, animal_info$sex)
```

sccomp
```{r sccomp}
sccomp_formula = ~fad + sex
model <- cluster_counts %>%
  sccomp_estimate(
    formula_composition = sccomp_formula,
    sample     = "animal_id",
    cell_group = "cluster",
    abundance  = "count",
    bimodal_mean_variability_association = TRUE
  )
model <- model %>% sccomp_remove_outliers(percent_false_positive = 10)

contrast_formula = "fadFAD"
contrast_result <- model %>%
    sccomp_test(contrast_formula, test_composition_above_logit_fold_change = 0)

```

voomCLR
```{r voomclr}
counts_wide <- cluster_counts |>
  select(cluster, animal_id, count) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = animal_id, values_from = count, values_fill = 0) |>
  column_to_rownames("cluster")

animal_meta <- animal_info |>
  filter(animal_id %in% colnames(counts_wide)) |>
  arrange(match(animal_id, colnames(counts_wide)))
stopifnot(identical(as.character(animal_meta$animal_id), colnames(counts_wide)))

design_mat <- model.matrix(~ fad + sex, data = animal_meta)
colnames(design_mat) <- make.names(colnames(design_mat))

# voomCLR
v <- voomCLR(counts_wide, design = design_mat, varCalc = "analytical")
fit <- lmFit(v, design_mat)

# contrast: ad - ctl
contrasts <- makeContrasts(tg_vs_ctl = "fadFAD", levels = design_mat)
contFit <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrasts = contrasts)
contFit <- eBayes(contFit)

voomclr_results <- topTableBC(contFit, coef = 1, n = Inf,
                 bootstrap = "parametric",
                 voomWeights = v$weights,
                 contrastMatrix = contrasts[, 1, drop = FALSE],
                 adjust.method = "BH") %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "cluster") %>%
  mutate(contrast = "5xfad_vs_ctl")
```

ANCOM-BC2
```{r ancombc2}
count_mat <- as.matrix(counts_wide)

animal_meta_df <- animal_meta |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  remove_rownames() |>
  column_to_rownames("animal_id")
animal_meta_df <- animal_meta_df[colnames(count_mat), ]

tse <- TreeSummarizedExperiment(
  assays  = list(counts = count_mat),
  colData = animal_meta_df
)

out <- ancombc2(
  data         = tse,
  assay_name   = "counts",
  fix_formula  = "fad + sex",
  p_adj_method = "BH",
  prv_cut      = 0,        # keep every cluster; there are only a handful
  verbose      = FALSE
)

ancombc_results <- out$res |>
  transmute(cluster  = taxon,
            contrast = "fad_vs_nonfad",
            lfc   = lfc_fadFAD,
            se    = se_fadFAD,
            p_val = p_fadFAD,
            q_val = q_fadFAD)

library(ANCOMBC)
library(TreeSummarizedExperiment)

count_mat <- cluster_counts %>%
  select(cluster, animal_id, count) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = animal_id, values_from = count, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("cluster") %>%
  as.matrix()

meta_df <- cluster_counts %>%
  distinct(animal_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  column_to_rownames("animal_id")
meta_df <- meta_df[colnames(count_mat), ]
meta_df$fad <- relevel(factor(meta_df$fad), ref = "nonFAD")

tse <- TreeSummarizedExperiment(
  assays  = list(counts = count_mat),
  colData = meta_df
)

out <- ancombc2(
  data        = tse,
  assay_name  = "counts",
  fix_formula = "fad + sex",
  p_adj_method = "BH",
  verbose     = FALSE
)
term_name = "fadFAD"
ancombc_results <- out$res %>%
  dplyr::select(taxon,
         lfc = starts_with("lfc_fadFAD"),
         se  = starts_with("se_fadFAD"),
         p_val = starts_with("p_fadFAD"),
         q_val = starts_with("q_fadFAD")) %>%
  mutate(cluster  = taxon,
         contrast = "tg_vs_ctl") %>%
  select(cluster, contrast, lfc, se, p_val, q_val)

```

```{r combine}
sccomp_collected <- contrast_result |>
  transmute(cluster = as.character(cluster), contrast = parameter,
            framework = "sccomp",
            effect    = c_effect,
            direction = ifelse(c_effect > 0, "up", "down"),
            adj_p_val = c_FDR,
            raw_p_val = NA_real_)

#sccomp doesn't provide raw p values, so will just leave the adjusted one here (relative to other members of its class)
focus_clusters <- c("microglia-4", "microglia-5")

# two-sided -> one-sided p for H1: effect > 0 (symmetric t / z statistics)
one_sided_up <- function(p_two, effect) if_else(effect > 0, p_two / 2, 1 - p_two / 2)

voomclr_collected <- voomclr_results |>
  filter(cluster %in% focus_clusters) |>
  transmute(cluster, contrast,
            framework = "voomclr",
            effect    = logFC,
            direction = ifelse(logFC > 0, "up", "down"),
            raw_p_two = P.Value,
            raw_p_val = one_sided_up(P.Value, logFC)) |>
  mutate(adj_p_val = p.adjust(raw_p_val, method = "bonferroni"),
         method    = "one-sided (up), bonferroni")

ancombc_collected <- ancombc_results |>
  filter(cluster %in% focus_clusters) |>
  transmute(cluster, contrast,
            framework = "ancombc2",
            effect    = lfc,
            direction = ifelse(lfc > 0, "up", "down"),
            raw_p_two = p_val,
            raw_p_val = one_sided_up(p_val, lfc)) |>
  mutate(adj_p_val = p.adjust(raw_p_val, method = "bonferroni"),
         method    = "one-sided (up), bonferroni")


combined_results <- bind_rows(sccomp_collected, voomclr_collected, ancombc_collected)


combined_results = combined_results %>% filter(cluster %in% c("microglia-4","microglia-5"))
# --- consensus: significant in >= 2 of the 3 frameworks, same direction -------
sig_at_least_2 <- combined_results |>
  mutate(raw_p_val = coalesce(raw_p_val, 1)) |>
  filter(raw_p_val < .1 | adj_p_val < .1) |>
  group_by(cluster, direction) |>
  filter(n() >= 2) |>
  ungroup()

sig_at_least_2

# Everything side by side
combined_results |>
  select(cluster, framework, effect, adj_p_val) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = framework, values_from = c(effect, adj_p_val)) |>
  arrange(cluster)
```

  mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, levels = str_sort(unique(as.character(cluster)), numeric = TRUE)))

sig_star <- function(p) {
  case_when(p < 0.001 ~ "***",
            p < 0.01  ~ "**",
            p < 0.05  ~ "*",
            TRUE      ~ "ns")
}

plot_focus <- function(focus_cluster) {
  # sccomp FDR for 5xFAD vs Ntg in this cluster
  sccomp_fdr <- contrast_result |>
    filter(as.character(cluster) == focus_cluster) |>
    pull(c_FDR)

  df    <- filter(prop_plot_df, cluster == focus_cluster)
  y_top <- max(df$proportion) * 1.08

  ggplot(df, aes(x = fad, y = proportion, fill = fad)) +
    geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE) +
    geom_jitter(aes(shape = sex, color = trem2), width = .1, size = 2.5) +
    geom_signif(
      data = data.frame(xmin = 1, xmax = 2,
                        annotations = sig_star(sccomp_fdr),
                        y_position  = y_top),
      aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, annotations = annotations, y_position = y_position),
      manual      = TRUE,
      textsize    = 6,
      vjust       = 0.3,
      tip_length  = 0.02,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.12))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(nonFAD = "#a1bad4", FAD = "#f6b2ba"), guide = "none") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(WT = "black", R47H = "#D55E00"),
                       labels = c(WT = "*Trem2*<sup>WT</sup>", R47H = "*Trem2*<sup>R47H</sup>"),
                       name   = "*Trem2*") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c(nonFAD = "Ntg", FAD = "5XFAD")) +
    labs(x = NULL,
         y = paste("Proportion mapped to", focus_cluster),
         shape = "Sex") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
    theme(axis.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
          axis.text    = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
          legend.title = element_markdown(),
          legend.text  = element_markdown(),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}

full_plot <- plot_focus("microglia-4") + plot_focus("microglia-5") +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")


ggsave("merfish_validation_microglia.pdf", full_plot, width = 10, height = 5)



combined_plot <- dam_validation_on_sections / full_plot +
  plot_layout(heights = c(2, 1))

combined_plot

ggsave("merfish_validation_microglia_combined.pdf", combined_plot,
       width = 10, height = 15)

Plot DAM 1 / 2 markers alongside general dam markers (log1p normalized)
```{r}
#markers present from Deczkowska et al, 2018 (Disease-Associated Microglia: A Universal Immune Sensor of Neurodegeneration)
#homeostatic: "P2ry12", "Tmem119", "Hexb"
#Stage 1 DAM upregulated - "Apoe", "Trem2", 
#stage 2 dam upregulated - "Cst7", "Itgax","Ccl6","Csf1"
dam_markers <- tibble(
  gene     = c("P2ry12", "Tmem119", "Hexb",
               "Apoe", "Trem2",
               "Cst7", "Itgax", "Ccl6", "Csf1"),
  category = c(rep("Homeostatic", 3), rep("Higher in Stage 1\nDAM than Homeostatic", 2), rep("Higher in Stage 2 DAM\nthan Stage 1 DAM", 4))
) |>
  mutate(category = factor(category, levels = unique(category)))

# --- log1p normalize (CP10k; library size from all kept panel genes) ---------
mic_mat  <- as(LayerData(mic_seurat, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts"), "IterableMatrix")
mic_norm <- multiply_cols(mic_mat, 1 / Matrix::colSums(mic_mat))
mic_norm <- log1p(mic_norm * 1e4)

present <- dam_markers$gene[dam_markers$gene %in% rownames(mic_norm)]
setdiff(dam_markers$gene, present)   # markers missing from panel / removed by the >=50 cell filter
mic_norm <- mic_norm[present, ]

# --- z-score each gene across all microglia, at the cell level ---------------
stats   <- matrix_stats(mic_norm, row_stats = "variance")
gene_mu <- stats$row_stats["mean", ]
gene_sd <- sqrt(stats$row_stats["variance", ])
mic_z   <- (mic_norm - gene_mu) / gene_sd

# --- pseudobulk by mapped cluster ---------------------------------------------
cell_cluster <- mic_seurat$rf_cluster[colnames(mic_z)]

percent_pseudobulk <- (mic_mat[present, ] > 0) |>
  pseudobulk_matrix(cell_groups = cell_cluster, method = "mean", threads = 8L)

z_pseudobulk <- mic_z |>
  pseudobulk_matrix(cell_groups = cell_cluster, method = "mean", threads = 8L)

# --- long format for plotting -------------------------------------------------
pb_long <- function(pb, value_name) {
  as.data.frame(as.matrix(pb)) |>
    rownames_to_column("gene") |>
    pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "cluster", values_to = value_name)
}


cluster_levels <- c("Microglia-1", "Microglia-2", "Microglia-3",
                    "Microglia-4 (Stage 2 DAM)", "Microglia-5 (Stage 1 DAM)",
                    "Microglia-6", "Microglia-7", "Microglia-8", "Microglia-9")

dotplot_df <- inner_join(pb_long(z_pseudobulk, "avg_exp"),
                         pb_long(percent_pseudobulk, "pct_exp"),
                         by = c("gene", "cluster")) |>
  mutate(pct_exp = pct_exp * 100) |>#fraction to %
  left_join(dam_markers, by = "gene") |> #add label
  mutate(cluster = str_to_title(cluster),
         cluster = case_when(
           cluster == "Microglia-4" ~ "Microglia-4 (Stage 2 DAM)",
           cluster == "Microglia-5" ~ "Microglia-5 (Stage 1 DAM)",
           .default = cluster
         ),
         gene    = factor(gene, levels = present),
         cluster = factor(cluster, levels = cluster_levels))


stopifnot(!anyNA(dotplot_df$cluster))   # catches any label/level mismatch

# --- dotplot ------------------------------------------------------------------
dam_marker_plot <- ggplot(dotplot_df, aes(x = gene, y = cluster, fill = avg_exp, size = pct_exp)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black") +
  facet_grid(~ category, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 10, name = "Percent\nExpressed") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(mid = "white", high = "#D55E00", low = "#0072B2", name = "Scaled\nLog-Normalized\nExpression") +
  ggtitle("") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(angle = 45)) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = .5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold.italic"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.key.size = unit(.5, "cm")
  ) +
  labs(x = "Gene", y = "Mapped Cluster",)

dam_marker_plot
ggsave("merfish_dam_marker_dotplot.pdf", dam_marker_plot, width = 10, height = 4)
```
